scope: English voice interfaces for existing coding agents and local conversational alternatives. Manually checked source evidence; no local model benchmark.

machines.label: RTX A6000 · 48 GiB
machines.note: PC: 128 GiB class system RAM, Windows 11 / WSL2. Capacity verified; free memory changes with other workloads.

machines.label: RTX 4070 Ti SUPER · 16 GiB
machines.note: Same PC, separate GPU. Its memory is not pooled with the A6000 for these runtime assessments.

machines.label: Apple M4 Max · 64 GiB
machines.note: Mac: live inventory verified 2026-10-23. Unified memory is shared with macOS and applications; 64 GiB is not all available to inference.

sources.title: VoiceChat MLX Swift port and benchmark conditions

rows.runtime: Proposed Scrivo / ASR → real Codex or Claude Code session → Kokoro

interaction.text: Start with turn-based speech, then add interruption and spoken progress. The agent keeps working between spoken updates.

persona.text: Choose the voice in TTS; choose the reasoning model and effort inside the agent harness.

evidence.text: Preserve session context, agent loop, tools and permissions through the actual harness. A chat-completions endpoint alone does not establish this integration.

languages.text: English target. Scrivo offers local dictation; Nemotron 0.6B is an English streaming ASR option. Kokoro supplies speech output.

caveat.text: Recommended architecture for sustained coding work; this bridge has not been connected or benchmarked here. Local speech does not make the selected hosted coding model local.
